input.quote: (but not less than $____ per month for the Hosting Services and $____ per month for Support Services)
input.rationale: Section 5a does impose a minimum monthly fee for Hosting and Support Services, so the arrangement is not at the preferred "usage/ordered services only" position. It sits at the fallback, however: the term is a single 12-month period (Section 13), and Section 14 gives Client an unconditional right to terminate effective the last day of the month following notice, with a further right not to renew on 30 days' notice — so the commitment never extends beyond the current 12-month term and is exitable on short notice. There is no shortfall payment, liquidated damages or take-or-pay mechanic; Client simply pays the monthly minimum while service is live, and no volume caps are imposed on Client usage. Two points to note commercially rather than redline: the minimum amounts are left blank ($____) and should be set at or below expected usage, and Section 6 excludes the minimum monthly fees from Client's supporting-documentation and dispute rights (an invoicing/audit point handled under that rule).
